# Cncf Openeverest Reviewer

Review OpenEverest using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Database category. The open-source platform for automated database provisioning and management. It supports multiple database technologies and can be hosted on any Kubernetes infrastructure, in the cloud or on-premises.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
